title: ExplainOutput
description: Release-pinned field guidance emitted by goobers explain.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the explain-command output contract.

version.description: Goobers build version that embedded the selected schema.

commit.description: Source commit of the Goobers build that embedded the selected schema.

dslVersion.description: Current workflow DSL version of the producing build.

selector.description: Requested dotted or slash-separated schema selector.

description.description: Purpose of the selected field, sourced from its schema description or synthesized from its contract location.

type.description: JSON Schema type declared or implied by the selected node, including composition unions.

allowedValues.description: Exact enum values, or the single const value, declared by the selected schema node or its array item schema.

default.description: Exact default annotation from the selected schema node.

required.description: Whether the selected property appears in its parent schema's required list.

stability.description: Lifecycle stability from the built-in DSL feature registry or embedded schema registry.

sinceVersion.description: Release in which the field's current lifecycle began.

example.description: Minimal example projected from the selected schema node.
